text:
ravi: Planning a short rolling maintenance for apac-east (2026-04-10 23:30-01:30 UTC). Scope: NIC microcode + PSU soft-firmware + controlled GPU soft reboots. Goal: no hard evacs, use soft-drain and KV preheat. Expect ~3-8% capacity reduction per cohort for ~20-35m. tagging ops/oncall.

jess: Which pools are in-scope? Any impact to reserved/Dedicated capacity?

mika: Reserved/Dedicated = NO TOUCH. In-scope = ephemeral, spot, autoscale-unpinned pools and test fleets. I'll produce the exact pool list in the drive doc.

ravi: Good. Primary concerns: KV cache readiness, cross-region overflow plan for latency-sensitive serving, and egress costs if we backfill across regions.

oliver: I can run a quick capacity projection Friday afternoon. Also need to confirm KV cache health metrics per cohort.

infra-bot: Preflight run (apac-east) completed. ALERT: cohort-2 KV cache fill = 78% (threshold 90%). Also observed higher-than-normal IO on rack-r12.

jess: We should schedule a KV-seed job for cohort-2 and bump cache retention 90m before start. Any objections to running adaptive-batching during the window?

mika: adaptive-batching = yes. reduces tail latency spikes. We'll enable it and lower max-batch-size by 20% during window.

ravi: KV-seed scheduled for 22:50 UTC. Command to trigger locally:
```
./ops/kv_seed.sh --region apac-east --cohort 2 --target 95
```

oliver: Reboot order proposal: low-traffic cohorts -> test fleets -> cohort-2 (post-KV-seed check) -> thermal-priority racks last. Will post per-rack ETA in drive.

jess: Cost estimate for cross-region backfill? rough numbers OK.

billing-bot: Estimated uplift for backfill (based on historical cohort sizes): +10-16% GPU-hours, +18-25% egress. Rough cost delta: $2.5k-$9k depending on cohort scale.

mika: Add billing alert for +12% above baseline during window. Also set a temporary cap on automated scale-ups to avoid runaway cost.

ravi: Oncall: @mika will be primary, @oliver secondary. Ping if p99 latency >2.5x or error rate >0.8%.

mika: I'll be in channel and watching the rollout dashboard. Preflight checklist linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maintenance-preflight.

infra-bot: Reminder: run the local preflight before the job: 
``
./ops/preflight.sh --region apac-east --cohorts 1,2,3
```

jess: Also check tenant scheduled jobs in apac-east 12h window. I'll notify account team for any enterprise customers.

ravi: Final note: we'll refrain from kernel-level reboots; this is userland soft-reboot only. Post a 24h notice to status page and customer comms. I'll update with cohort start times ~12h prior. :thumbsup:
